description: This file defines an API endpoint class 'CandidateAllowedActionAPI' in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, responsible for retrieving allowed actions for a specific candidate within the recruitment workflow. It includes methods for fetching permissible actions based on candidate ID, candidate vacancy status, user roles, and interview counts, implementing business logic for recruitment process management.

classes.name: CandidateAllowedActionAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class to fetch allowed recruitment actions for a candidate, implementing business logic based on candidate status, role permissions, and interview counts.

methods.name: getAll

methods.name: isHiringManager
